themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents designed to perform research tasks, analyze data, or interact with systems autonomously to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools designed to help developers write, debug, review, and understand code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and applications specifically built to aid researchers in data collection, analysis, and insight generation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for testing, research, or content generation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI capabilities that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries or key insights.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is used in the design process, from ideation and prototyping to user interface and experience research.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI's role in analyzing user feedback, emotions, and opinions expressed in text or other forms.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use of AI chatbots for research purposes, including user interaction, data gathering, and analysis.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications used to understand market needs, analyze product performance, and inform product development.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles comparing, reviewing, or assessing the effectiveness and capabilities of various AI tools for research and design.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
